name: cc-agy-plugin
description: Delegate coding, batch edits, and reviews to Gemini via your Gemini Enterprise subscription (agy CLI), Google AI Studio, or Vertex AI (Antigravity SDK) with isolated git copies and signed receipts.

interface.shortDescription: Run Gemini coding workers safely in isolated git copies with signed receipts.
interface.longDescription: Delegate multi-file edits, debugging, and code reviews from Codex to Gemini models (gemini-flash-next and gemini-4-argon) via your Gemini Enterprise subscription (`agy` CLI), Google AI Studio, or Vertex AI (`google-antigravity` SDK).
capabilities: Signed cost receipts and one-call undo
defaultPrompt: Use delegate_start to fix the failing tests and show the diff.
Ask Gemini to review the current diff for functional bugs.
Run doctor to verify Gemini credentials and cost settings.
